body.html: Topland Hotel Phitsanulok sits on Akathodsarot Road in Nai Mueang, Mueang Phitsanulok. The thing guests mention most is its downtown location connected directly to Topland Plaza mall from the lobby · you can walk from your room into the mall, browse the supermarket, food court or catch a movie without stepping out into the sun. Open since 2010 and given a major renovation in 2023, it has 252 rooms and is a regular base for business travellers, conference groups and families exploring Phitsanulok, because food and shopping are right there.

After location, what guests praise most is clean, comfortably sized rooms that feel good value for a 4-star hotel · many reviews note soft beds, cold air conditioning, a bathtub in the bathroom and full basics including a fridge, minibar and flat-screen TV · staff earn praise for being friendly and helpful · service scores 8.9 and location a high 9.3 in reviews, which shows guests are happiest with those two things.
"Super central location — you can walk into the mall right from the lobby. The room was clean, the bed comfy, and Wat Yai is just a few minutes' walk. Great value for a 4-star."

Another thing that sets Topland apart from the usual city hotel is having all the facilities in one place · there's an outdoor pool plus a children's pool, a spa and massage rooms, a fitness centre, and four restaurants including the Dynasty Chinese restaurant that locals know well · it's a hotel with a large convention centre and banquet halls, so it suits seminars and weddings too · there's free parking, a lift, laundry service and a 24-hour front desk that's good at recommending where to eat and what to see around town.

Location is the main advantage for anyone exploring central Phitsanulok · it's about a 10-minute walk to Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat (Wat Yai), home of the revered Phra Buddha Chinnarat, plus the Nan River and Phitsanulok train station · in the evening you can stroll along the Nan and pay respects to Phra Buddha Chinnarat without needing a car · a short drive reaches the city's markets and well-known restaurants, and it makes a handy base before driving on to Sukhothai, Khao Kho or Phu Hin Rong Kla · during the Phra Buddha Chinnarat festival and peak travel season rooms fill fast and prices rise.

To be straight about it, this is a hotel that opened back in 2010, and even with the 2023 renovation some areas still feel dated · several reviews say the furniture and decor look old in places, some rooms can smell a little musty, and rooms on the main-road side may pick up traffic noise · breakfast has a fair spread but some reviewers wished for better bread options and coffee/milk quality · when conference groups check in at the same time the lift can mean a wait and the lobby gets busy.

Service is the warm, capable style of a large provincial city hotel · the front desk runs 24 hours, staff speak reasonable English and are helpful · there's luggage storage, laundry, currency exchange and a tour desk · free on-site parking, and a direct link into the mall with its restaurants and supermarket · overall it's a place built around location, having everything in one building, and value, rather than newness or modern design — which is exactly what most people visiting and doing business in Phitsanulok are looking for.

In short, Topland Hotel Phitsanulok suits anyone who wants a 4-star downtown hotel that has everything on hand and lets you walk to Wat Yai and the riverside · if you're after a stylish new boutique hotel or a quiet riverside resort, this may not be your answer · but if what you want is a clean, roomy stay, a central location linked to the mall, and a pool and restaurants all in one building at an accessible price — this delivers that genuinely well.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for a higher floor away from the main road if you want quiet and a city view · if you're travelling with family, ask for a room near the pool and children's pool · during seminar periods, avoid checking in at peak hours so you don't wait for the lift, and book ahead during the Phra Buddha Chinnarat festival as rooms go fast.

honestSummary: Topland Hotel Phitsanulok is best for travellers who want a 4-star downtown hotel that has everything on hand and lets you walk to Wat Yai and the riverside · its appeal is the central location linked directly to the mall, clean and roomy rooms, and a full set of facilities in one building — not newness or modern design · you have to accept a building that feels dated in places and some traffic noise on the main-road side, but in return you get convenience and value that's hard to match in town.
honestChecks: If you're after a stylish new boutique hotel or a quiet riverside resort — this is a large City Convention hotel focused on location and convenience, with a building dating to 2010 → if newness and a quiet setting matter most, consider a boutique stay along the Nan River instead.

If you're sensitive to noise or musty smells — main-road-side rooms can catch traffic noise and some reviews mention a musty smell → ask for a higher floor away from the road, and request a room change straight away if you notice an odour.

If you're visiting during a seminar or banquet period — the lobby can get crowded and the lift can mean a wait at simultaneous check-in → avoid peak check-in hours and book ahead during the Phra Buddha Chinnarat festival.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Topland Hotel Phitsanulok

faq.q: Where is Topland Hotel Phitsanulok and what's nearby?
faq.a: Topland Hotel is at 68/33 Akathodsarot Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Phitsanulok, right downtown · it's connected directly to Topland Plaza mall from the lobby, and about a 10-minute walk from Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat (Wat Yai), the Nan River and Phitsanulok train station · the airport is roughly a 15-minute drive.

faq.q: How much does Topland Hotel Phitsanulok cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿950/night for a Standard Room · rising through Superior Double/Twin, Deluxe/Connecting Room and Family Suite · prices rise during the Phra Buddha Chinnarat festival and peak season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Topland Hotel Phitsanulok best for?
faq.a: It's great for anyone who wants a 4-star downtown hotel that has everything on hand and lets you walk to Wat Yai and the riverside · it suits business travellers, conference groups and families who want a pool and a mall in one building · a handy base before driving on to Sukhothai, Khao Kho or Phu Hin Rong Kla · less ideal if you're after a stylish new boutique or a quiet riverside resort.

faq.q: What are the rooms and facilities like at Topland Hotel?
faq.a: Highlights are clean, comfortably sized rooms with soft beds, a bathtub, fridge, minibar and flat-screen TV · plus all the facilities in one building — an outdoor pool and children's pool, spa, fitness centre, four restaurants including the Dynasty Chinese restaurant, and a convention centre — with a direct link into Topland mall.

faq.q: What should I know before staying at Topland Hotel Phitsanulok?
faq.a: Reviews note that this hotel opened in 2010 and, despite the 2023 renovation, some furniture and decor still look dated · main-road-side rooms can catch traffic noise and some rooms can smell musty · the lift can mean a wait during simultaneous group check-ins, and breakfast bread options and coffee/milk quality could be better.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, and can I cancel?
faq.a: During the Phra Buddha Chinnarat festival and peak season, book several weeks ahead as rooms fill fast and prices rise · at other times a few days is fine · every platform offers a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm.
